title: ArtifactType
description: The kind of generated artifact a project version can carry. A closed enum: a consumer must never have to guess how to interpret an artifact, and an unknown value must fail validation rather than be rendered blindly. Spec 001 produces only preview_image (a fast, deterministic still image proving a mutation is visible). Reserved for later milestones, each of which needs its own media_type handling and a decision about who may request it: render_image (final Cycles render), glb_scene (interactive browser preview), viewport_stream (live viewport).
